metadata.title: MedOrbits Admissions Database
metadata.description: Structured admission information for courses, institutions, countries and academic years.
metadata.timezonePolicy: Use the official timezone applicable to the admission authority.
metadata.verificationPolicy: Verify eligibility, deadlines and application instructions against current official sources before publication.

dataRules: Every admission record must have a unique id.
courseId must reference an existing course record.
institutionId may be null when admission is managed by a central authority rather than a single institution.
countryCode must use an appropriate ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code.
academicYear must identify the applicable admission cycle.
Dates must use YYYY-MM-DD or null when unknown or not applicable.
applicationEnd must not precede applicationStart when both dates are provided.
officialUrl must point to an authoritative institution, regulator, examination authority or counselling portal.
sourceUrl should identify the source used to support the published admission information.
verifiedAt must be null until the record has actually been verified.
verifiedBy must identify an authorized reviewer or system when verification is recorded.
Unverified records must not be presented as officially confirmed.
Expired deadlines and outdated notifications must be reviewed before being displayed as current.
The active field controls whether a record is enabled for normal application display; it does not indicate that applications are open.
Never invent eligibility requirements, application dates, official links or verification details.
note: Use current official notifications for eligibility and deadlines. MedOrbits provides informational guidance and does not replace official admission authorities.
